title: Fort Témiscamingue Eastern Storehouse

terrainReference.basis: Original present-day terrain beside the estimated western threshold.

mapIdentity.provider: Parks Canada archaeological site inventory and mapped trading-post context
mapIdentity.scope: Placed inland and slightly north of the western trade store to reconstruct the excavated commercial pair. The 16 m east and 6 m north offsets, building outline and bearing are estimates.

note: The 1997 excavations name the eastern storehouse. Roy identifies two historical stock buildings as numbers 16 and 17. The 1876 Qualla photo supplies general gable and timber character. Its distant buildings do not independently identify the eastern storehouse.
